title: Decentralized Stability-Constrained Optimal Power Flow for Inverter-Based Power Systems
summary: Future inverter-dominated power systems feature higher variability and more stressed operating conditions, which motivates the consideration of stability in operational settings. Existing approaches to stability-constrained OPF often rely on eigenvalue calculation, global model information, or dynamic evaluation inside optimization formulation, which are computationally intensive and difficult to scale.
